INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY MINUTES - 06/05/13 - 6PM
MINUTES
INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY MINUTES - 06/05/13 - 6PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
JUNE 5, 2013
AGENDA NO. 47
www.cityofpalmdale.org
1.
JOINT CALL TO ORDER OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY.
Mayor/Chair Ledford called the meetings to order at 6:00 p.m.
2.
JOINT ROLL CALL: MAYOR/CHAIR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM/VICE CHAIR/CHAIR PRO TEM LACKEY, COUNCILMEMBER/MEMBER/DIRECTOR BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, AND HOFBAUER
Present - Mayor/Chair Ledford
Present - Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair/Chair Pro Tem Lackey
Present - Councilmember/Member/Director Bettencourt
Present - Councilmember/Member/Director Dispenza
Present - Councilmember/Member/Director Hofbauer
Mayor/Chair Ledford opened the Housing Authority Meeting and took Housing Authority roll call at this time.
3.
JOINT BUDGET WORK SESSION AND DISCUSSION OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, HOUSING AUTHORITY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY:
3.1
Review and discussion of the City Council, Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Industrial Development Authority, Palmdale Airport Authority, Palmdale Civic Authority, and Palmdale Financing Authority Budgets for Fiscal Year 2013/2014. (Staff Reference: City Manager/Executive Director Childs and Department Heads and Managers).
For detailed information on this Joint Item, please refer to the City Council June 5, 2013 6:00 p.m. meeting minutes.
4.
JOINT PUBLIC COMMENTS OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, HOUSING AUTHORITY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY:
None.
5.
ADJOURNMENT:
Mayor/Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 7:20 p.m. to June 5, 2013 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 4th day of June 2014.
___________________________________
James C. Ledford, Jr., Chair
